rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader {
    meta:
        description = "Detects dynamic loading of DLLs via rundll32 from temporary directories"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "MITRE T1218.011"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $rundll_cmd = /rundll32\.exe .*\\Temp\\.*\.dll,.*/ nocase
        $powershell_parent = /ParentImage.*outlook\.exe/ nocase
    condition:
        $rundll_cmd and $powershell_parent
}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTP_Request {
    meta:
        description = "Detects HTTP User-Agent patterns associated with Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $ua1 = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" fullword ascii
        $ua2 = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36" fullword ascii
        $cookie = /[A-Z]{8}-[A-Z]{4}-[A-Z]{4}-[A-Z]{4}-[A-Z]{12}/
    condition:
        (http_request_method == "GET" or http_request_method == "POST") and
        (http_host != "") and
        ($ua1 or $ua2) and
        $cookie and
        http_uri == "/"
}
